notes.title: Pandamonium Demo Update!
notes.notes:
A new update has been added for our demo!

We have added a whole new level which is double the size of the first level!

We are also glad to announce we are taking part in Steam Next Fest starting Feb 06th (10am pacific) till Feb 13th.

Please do let us know what you think about it or any feedback on it will be much appreciated.

Do watch out for our livestreams in the upcoming days!

Thanks and Enjoy :)
